name: Blood Stance
description: Samurai gains 35% area and 30% attack speed, but deals 30% less damage. Multiplicative with other upgrades. Choose only one stance per run; effect upgrades remain mixable.

name: Execution Stance
description: Samurai gains 35% area and 80% damage, but attacks 35% slower. Multiplicative with other upgrades. Choose only one stance per run; effect upgrades remain mixable.

name: Blade Wave Stance
description: Samurai gains 25% damage and 25% attack speed, but loses 35% melee reach and wave width. Wave travel distance is unchanged. Multiplicative with other upgrades. Choose only one stance per run. Blade Wave is unlocked separately.

name: Blood Transfer
description: When a bleeding enemy dies, share 50% of its remaining Bleed damage among up to 5 nearby enemies within 300 cm, scaling with Samurai area. Keeps the remaining duration. Transferred damage is not multiplied again; later transfers diminish it further.

name: Bloodletting
description: Normal Samurai melee and Blade Wave hits apply 1 additional Bleed stack per rank. Each stack gains the applying hit's Bleed damage contribution. Maximum 3 ranks.

name: Lingering Wounds
description: Increase the duration of newly applied Bleed. Longer-lasting wounds leave more damage to transfer on death.

name: Quickened Cuts
format: +{Percent}% Samurai attack speed. Stance multipliers still apply.

name: Overkill Burst
description: Direct Samurai melee and Blade Wave killing blows explode for their excess damage in a 220 cm radius, scaling with Samurai area. A 150-damage hit killing a 40-HP enemy explodes for 110 damage. Assists, Bleed and explosion kills do not trigger explosions.

name: Wave Volley
description: Each committed Samurai swing launches 1 additional Blade Wave per rank, up to 3 additional waves. Requires Blade Wave. Additional waves share normal wave damage, width, returning behavior and scaling. Combines with Crossing Blades.
